_comment: Dedicated tsconfig for the design-sync esbuild bundle. baseUrl is the repo root (../ from .design-sync/). Maps the @/ alias plus browser stubs for next/* so the component bundle resolves and renders outside Next.

compilerOptions._comment_dirs: Explicit file targets for @/ specifiers that resolve to a directory (or a file shadowed by a same-named dir). Must precede @/* so the esbuild paths plugin returns the file, not the directory.
